g.text: Isolation anomalies — what concurrent transactions do to each other
Each panel is one interleaving that a weaker isolation level allows.
reading something that was never committed
the same row changes underneath you
the same range gains or loses rows
each check passes; together they break the rule
Repeatable Read + stops non-repeatable reads and lost updates
Serializable + stops phantoms and write skew
Why write skew is the nasty one
Write skew is the one that survives Repeatable Read / snapshot isolation.
Both transactions read a set, both decide independently, neither writes
the row the other read — so no conflict is detected.
